`GET /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members`

Returns the members of an organization with their user data, without paging.
Returns only the members you can read.
Use `/api/v2/organizations/{organization}/paginated-members` instead.

`GET /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/roles`

Returns the roles that apply in an organization, built-in and custom.

`PUT /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/roles`

Replaces the display name and permissions of an existing custom role, identified by `name` in the request body.

`POST /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/roles`

## Get organization member

### Code samples

```sh
# Example request using curl
curl -X GET http://coder-server:8080/api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/{user} \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Coder-Session-Token: API_KEY'
```

`GET /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/{user}`

Returns one organization member with their user data, such as username, email, status, and roles.
Returns only a member you can read.

### Parameters

| Name           | In   | Type   | Required | Description                                                       |
|----------------|------|--------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `organization` | path | string | true     | Organization ID, name, or `default` for the default organization. |
| `user`         | path | string | true     | User ID, username, or `me` for the authenticated user.            |

### Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "avatar_url": "string",
  "created_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "email": "string",
  "global_roles": [
    {
      "display_name": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "organization_id": "string"
    }
  ],
  "has_ai_seat": true,
  "is_service_account": true,
  "last_seen_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "login_type": "",
  "name": "string",
  "organization_id": "7c60d51f-b44e-4682-87d6-449835ea4de6",
  "roles": [
    {
      "display_name": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "organization_id": "string"
    }
  ],
  "status": "active",
  "updated_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "user_created_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "user_id": "a169451c-8525-4352-b8ca-070dd449a1a5",
  "user_updated_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "username": "string"
}
```

### Responses

| Status | Meaning                                                 | Description | Schema                                                                                       |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 200    | [OK](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.1) | OK          | [codersdk.OrganizationMemberWithUserData](schemas.md#codersdkorganizationmemberwithuserdata) |

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated. [Learn more](authentication.md).

## Add organization member

### Code samples

```sh
# Example request using curl
curl -X POST http://coder-server:8080/api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/{user} \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Coder-Session-Token: API_KEY'
```

`POST /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/{user}`

Adds an existing user to an organization with no roles beyond the organization's defaults.
Fails for an OIDC user while organization sync is enabled, because the identity provider controls that user's organizations.
Requires permission to read the user and to create organization members, which the Owner, User Admin, Organization Admin, and Organization User Admin roles have.

### Parameters

| Name           | In   | Type   | Required | Description                                                       |
|----------------|------|--------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `organization` | path | string | true     | Organization ID, name, or `default` for the default organization. |
| `user`         | path | string | true     | User ID, username, or `me` for the authenticated user.            |

### Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "created_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "organization_id": "7c60d51f-b44e-4682-87d6-449835ea4de6",
  "roles": [
    {
      "display_name": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "organization_id": "string"
    }
  ],
  "updated_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "user_id": "a169451c-8525-4352-b8ca-070dd449a1a5"
}
```

### Responses

| Status | Meaning                                                 | Description | Schema                                                               |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 200    | [OK](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.1) | OK          | [codersdk.OrganizationMember](schemas.md#codersdkorganizationmember) |

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated. [Learn more](authentication.md).

## Remove organization member

### Code samples

```sh
# Example request using curl
curl -X DELETE http://coder-server:8080/api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/{user} \
  -H 'Coder-Session-Token: API_KEY'
```

`DELETE /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/{user}`

Removes a user from an organization.
You can't remove yourself.
Requires permission to delete organization members, which the Owner, User Admin, Organization Admin, and Organization User Admin roles have.

### Parameters

| Name           | In   | Type   | Required | Description                                                       |
|----------------|------|--------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `organization` | path | string | true     | Organization ID, name, or `default` for the default organization. |
| `user`         | path | string | true     | User ID, username, or `me` for the authenticated user.            |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning                                                         | Description | Schema |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|--------|
| 204    | [No Content](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.5) | No Content  |        |

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated. [Learn more](authentication.md).

## Assign role to organization member

### Code samples

```sh
# Example request using curl
curl -X PUT http://coder-server:8080/api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/{user}/roles \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Coder-Session-Token: API_KEY'
```

`PUT /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/members/{user}/roles`

Replaces an organization member's roles with the roles in the request body.
You can't change your own roles, and you can't change the roles of an OIDC user while organization role sync is enabled.
Requires permission to assign organization roles, which the Owner, User Admin, Organization Admin, and Organization User Admin roles have.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "roles": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

### Parameters

| Name           | In   | Type                                                   | Required | Description                                                                           |
|----------------|------|--------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `organization` | path | string                                                 | true     | Organization ID, name, or `default` for the default organization.                     |
| `user`         | path | string                                                 | true     | User ID, username, or `me` for the authenticated user.                                |
| `body`         | body | [codersdk.UpdateRoles](schemas.md#codersdkupdateroles) | true     | Names of the roles to assign to the member. These replace the member's current roles. |

### Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "created_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "organization_id": "7c60d51f-b44e-4682-87d6-449835ea4de6",
  "roles": [
    {
      "display_name": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "organization_id": "string"
    }
  ],
  "updated_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
  "user_id": "a169451c-8525-4352-b8ca-070dd449a1a5"
}
```

### Responses

| Status | Meaning                                                 | Description | Schema                                                               |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 200    | [OK](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.1) | OK          | [codersdk.OrganizationMember](schemas.md#codersdkorganizationmember) |

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated. [Learn more](authentication.md).

## Paginated organization members

### Code samples

```sh
# Example request using curl
curl -X GET http://coder-server:8080/api/v2/organizations/{organization}/paginated-members \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Coder-Session-Token: API_KEY'
```

`GET /api/v2/organizations/{organization}/paginated-members`

Returns a page of the organization's members with their user data, ordered by username, along with the total count of matching members.
Use `q` to filter the members and `limit` with `offset` or `after_id` to page through them.
Requires permission to read all of the organization's members, which the Owner, Auditor, Template Admin, User Admin, Organization Admin, Organization Auditor, Organization User Admin, and Organization Template Admin roles have.

### Parameters

| Name           | In    | Type         | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|----------------|-------|--------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `organization` | path  | string       | true     | Organization ID, name, or `default` for the default organization.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `q`            | query | string       | false    | Search query in the format `key:value`. Available keys are: `name`, `username`, `email`, `status`, `service_account`, `role`, `last_seen_after`, `last_seen_before`, `created_after`, `created_before`, `github_com_user_id`, and `login_type`. Text without a key matches the username, name, or email. |
| `after_id`     | query | string(uuid) | false    | User ID of the last member on the previous page. Returns the members after it, which pages faster than `offset`.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `limit`        | query | integer      | false    | Maximum number of results to return. The default, `0`, returns all results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `offset`       | query | integer      | false    | Number of results to skip, for paging through results with `limit`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

### Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "count": 0,
    "members": [
      {
        "avatar_url": "string",
        "created_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
        "email": "string",
        "global_roles": [
          {
            "display_name": "string",
            "name": "string",
            "organization_id": "string"
          }
        ],
        "has_ai_seat": true,
        "is_service_account": true,
        "last_seen_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
        "login_type": "",
        "name": "string",
        "organization_id": "7c60d51f-b44e-4682-87d6-449835ea4de6",
        "roles": [
          {
            "display_name": "string",
            "name": "string",
            "organization_id": "string"
          }
        ],
        "status": "active",
        "updated_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
        "user_created_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
        "user_id": "a169451c-8525-4352-b8ca-070dd449a1a5",
        "user_updated_at": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
        "username": "string"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

### Responses

| Status | Meaning                                                 | Description | Schema                                                                                    |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 200    | [OK](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.1) | OK          | array of [codersdk.PaginatedMembersResponse](schemas.md#codersdkpaginatedmembersresponse) |

## Get site member roles

### Code samples

```sh
# Example request using curl
curl -X GET http://coder-server:8080/api/v2/users/roles \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Coder-Session-Token: API_KEY'
```

`GET /api/v2/users/roles`

Returns the site-wide roles, built-in and custom, that you can assign to users.
Each role has an `assignable` field that tells you whether you can assign it.
Requires permission to read role assignments, which the Owner and User Admin roles have.

]
